entries.notes: Coarse REGIONAL context DEM for the v003 general-terrain skirt covering the CAM_top blue-circle extent (~79x98 km around de Gerlache Rim 2). Fetched 2026-07-13; whole COG is 2.70 GB, cropped to the target window projwin -87500 54200 -8600 -44100 (projected m, S polar stereographic sphere 1737400 — same CRS as the 5 m Site11 tile) -> site11_regional_20mpp.tif -> dem_to_displacement.py. The 5 m Site11 tile is kept as the high-detail core inset; this 20 m DEM is background/skyline only. Whole-file deleted after crop; only the crop persists. Windowed /vsicurl read was unreliable against the PGDA server (produced all-nodata), so the whole file was fetched with aria2c and cropped locally.
